request.style: English, lo-fi hip hop at sunrise, soft boom bap drums, warm Rhodes and vinyl crackle, birdsong, a relaxed male vocal half-sung, hopeful and gentle, 82 BPM
request.lyrics:

Coffee getting cold again
Light is coming through
Yesterday was heavy
But this I call to mind
